text:
marie: quick check — I opened the onboarding PR for chronomancer-7b. CI shows a schema lint failure but I can't repro locally. Can someone eyeball config.json?

ci-bot: schema-lint failed on PR #472: missing required field 'tokenizer_path' and 'pad_token_id' type mismatch (expected int). See /ci/logs/472-lint.txt :warning:

devin: looking now. my local run passed because my env set TOKENIZER_OVERRIDE, which hid the missing field. hmm.

pradeep: main issues I see: weight_uri uses s3://redwood-onboard/weights/chronomancer-7b/ but the role used by dedicated CI doesn't have read perms on that bucket. ops-bot raised a permission error earlier.

jen: tokenizer here is a custom SentencePiece model. We need tokenizer_path to point at s3://tokenizers/chronomancer-7b/spm.model and pad_token_id must be an integer. Current config has "pad_token": "<pad>" instead of id. Also model_family is set to "gpt-like" — that'll skip some attention optimizations.

marie: ah ok — two separate fixes: 1) change pad_token -> pad_token_id with numeric id, 2) add tokenizer_path to S3 and update IAM for CI. Can someone propose the minimal config diff?

devin: minimal patch I tested locally:
```json
{"weight_uri": "s3://redwood-onboard/weights/chronomancer-7b/ggml.bin",
 "tokenizer_path": "s3://tokenizers/chronomancer-7b/spm.model",
 "pad_token_id": 0,
 "eos_token_id": 2,
 "context_window": 4096,
 "quantization": "int8",
 "model_family": "decoder-only"}
```
That passes the schema linter for required fields. We still need the IAM bit.

pradeep: I've just added the bucket-read role to the CI role for that prefix. Ops change will take ~10m to prop. I also added a quick schema validator rule to warn when pad_token is a string.

marie: sweet. devin can you update the PR with that json and a one-line explanation? I'll re-run CI after opsProp.

devin: on it. pinging @jen for tokenizer sanity check in case the spm model expects special_ids mapping.

jen: confirmed spm.model uses special_ids: {"pad":0,"eos":2,"unk":1}. Good to go. Also recommend adding a comment in config about allowed quantization values to avoid surprise.

ci-bot: CI re-run queued (PR #472) — waiting on ops role propagation.

marie: nice. follow-ups: add a short unit test in onboarding CI that loads tokenizer_path and checks special ids present, and add schema lint rule to map pad_token -> pad_token_id with a helpful error message. I'll add these to the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: bucket policy updated, role change propagated (approx 2m ago).

devin: PR updated and pushed. Thanks everyone — will merge once CI green.

marie: awesome, thanks. keeping this thread as the record for the fix. If CI still trips, we'll escalate to eng-infra.
